title: nazm.capabilities/1
description: What one build of the compiler supports, from `nazm capabilities --json`. One object on stdout, read from the compiler's own tables.

version.description: The compiler's version, so a report can be attributed to a build.

native_target.description: What `nazm build` has been verified against, verbatim from the emitter.

compiled.description: Whether `nazm build` lowers it. A built-in the front end has and the backend does not is refused by name, never approximated.

evidence.description: What establishes the row: a test file, or the document stating the limitation.
